relationships.subject: indazole compound 45
relationships.evidence_quote: the 2,4-difluorobenzyl analog 45 is a partial agonist of both hCB1 and hCB2

key_findings: SAR on right-side amide converts indazole full agonists of CB1/CB2 into partial agonists; compound 45 is a peripherally restricted, orally absorbed partial agonist (EC50 ~150 nM hCB1, 35 nM hCB2; <10% brain penetrance).
